theorem cmi06FabricationStationClosure :
    let firstOutletIn : Nat := 15
    let secondOutletIn : Nat := 87
    let thirdOutletIn : Nat := 159
    let fourthOutletIn : Nat := 231
    let branchOutletIn : Nat := 246
    let pieceLengthIn : Nat := 252
    And (firstOutletIn + 72 = secondOutletIn)
      (And (secondOutletIn + 72 = thirdOutletIn)
        (And (thirdOutletIn + 72 = fourthOutletIn)
          (And (fourthOutletIn + 15 = branchOutletIn)
            (branchOutletIn + 6 = pieceLengthIn)))) :=
by decide

theorem head057ExactVerticalDelta :
    let carrierElevationIn : Nat := 246
    let sprinklerElevationIn : Nat := 258
    let verticalLegLengthIn : Nat := 12
    carrierElevationIn + verticalLegLengthIn = sprinklerElevationIn :=
by decide

theorem boundedCmi06DoesNotPromoteWholeLayout :
    let cmi06PieceReady : Bool := true
    let fiveOutletFittingsReady : Bool := true
    let head057ExactVerticalLegReady : Bool := true
    let completeFittingScheduleReady : Bool := false
    let exactWholeSystemZReady : Bool := false
    let fieldDrainRoutesReady : Bool := false
    let sourceFeed3dPathReady : Bool := false
    let properPipeLayoutReady : Bool := false
    let fabricationReady : Bool := false
    And (cmi06PieceReady && fiveOutletFittingsReady && head057ExactVerticalLegReady = true)
      (And (completeFittingScheduleReady || exactWholeSystemZReady || fieldDrainRoutesReady || sourceFeed3dPathReady = false)
        (properPipeLayoutReady || fabricationReady = false)) :=
by decide
